items.title: Mastering automated agent performance evaluations in Amazon Connect Customer
items.summary: TEKsystems Global Services (TGS) helped a large media and entertainment enterprise transform their Amazon Connect Customer automated evaluation system from 66.67 percent accuracy to 100 percent. They developed a strategic classification framework that matches each evaluation question to the optimal automation method, either generative AI, conversational analytics categories, or contact metrics. This layered approach eliminated AI hallucinations, enabled full interaction coverage, and turned quality assurance from an unreliable manual process into a trusted, production-ready system that delivers actionable coaching insights at scale. As generative AI adoption accelerates, the gap between deploying automation and making it trustworthy is becoming the critical differentiator. The next frontier of multi-modal insights and real-time coaching starts with the right foundation.
